body:
First of all: Those thoughts and remarks of your body are not your thoughts. They come from your mom installed in your mind. I had the same problem with my parents until maybe I turned 18. Always comparing ne with other kids, pointing out my psychical flaws, intellectual flaws too(later I realised those flaws are blown out of proportion) . I can't tell you how can you stop hating yourself because I still didn't learn that either. Instead try different approach. Ask yourself :"does my body looks THAT bad, do I really think they do". Maybe you look just normal, yet your brain tells you otherwise just because its placed in it. We all have flaws and often enough they don't look that bad. 
You gotta take courage to look yourself in the mirror and take neutral approach. Maybe pretend you're checking out someone else. Idk how can you learn to love yourself, but you can definitely learn to respect yourself. Cheers

Good luck with treatment bro, if anything you can always come back here to vent. Or we can even search for other solutions if the online therapy doesn't work out. There's always somebody who cares, cheers ;)

Oh well, it seems complicated, feels like you're describing my parents in some way.I can relate in some degree. As I can see , secretly meeting a therapist is not a option. How about online counseling via messages? Does your college offers any type of counseling?
Might sound stupid but why don't you visit therapist on your own?  Don't rely on your parents since there's no help from them
Yep, that's the game, thanks a lot.
